triggers: 為什麼男生女生不一樣
deflection_zh: 這個問題很棒，我們回家一起問爸爸媽媽好嗎？

5-6: 先問孩子：你是從哪裡聽來的？
用正確的名字說身體部位，不用綽號
簡單說：寶寶在媽媽肚子裡慢慢長大
告訴孩子：身體隱私要自己保護好
7-8: 說明男生女生身體的不同，語氣自然
寶寶由爸爸的精子與媽媽的卵子結合而來
說明懷孕約九個月，寶寶在肚子裡長大
提醒：身體被碰觸不舒服，要告訴大人

what_not_to_say: 不要用「撿來的」或「神送來的」等說法
不要笑孩子的問題，或因害羞而迴避
不要用嚇人的話，例如「不能亂問」

sources.title: HealthyChildren.org - From the American Academy of Pediatrics

author: claude-haiku

en.deflection: That is a really good question! Let's ask your mom or dad together, okay?
triggers: how do babies get in the tummy
why are boys and girls different
why is mommy's tummy so big
how did i come out of mommy

5-6: First ask: where did you hear that?
Use the correct names for body parts, not nicknames.
Keep it simple: a baby grows inside mommy's tummy for a long time.
Tell your child their private body parts are theirs to protect.
7-8: Explain how boys' and girls' bodies are different, in a calm, natural tone.
A baby starts when a sperm from dad joins an egg from mom.
Explain that pregnancy lasts about nine months while the baby grows.
Remind them: if someone touches them in a way that feels wrong, tell a grown-up.

what_not_to_say: Don't say the baby was found somewhere or sent by God.
Don't laugh at the question or avoid it out of embarrassment.
Don't scare them with words like 'you must never ask that'.
